invariants.value: references first, per part: real pictures and sourced sizes before any shape (a dossier for a real object); add only detail the real object has, never detail to move a score
invariants.why: owner ruling 10-07; the score-chased starter props were graded 1/100

invariants.value: the model sheet is approved by the owner before any shape (lune run kit sheet <asset>; kit approve 3d <name> --stage sheet)
invariants.why: H1: the cheap approval before the expensive build

invariants.value: the blockout is approved before detail (kit approve 3d <name> --stage blockout)
real-world size: 1 stud = 0.28 m; an R6 is 5 studs tall; a sword about 1 x 4.5 x 0.3 studs
maps at 1028 px/m on a hero, 257 px/m on a prop, Roblox keeps up to 4096
build part by part through kit plan <asset>; organic parts picture-first against a checked reference (redraw large, generate, fold, sharpen), never typed from words as primitives
invariants.why: the dragon sword typed from SDF primitives: 'WEIRD AND UGLY' (1/10); the picture-first route amazed the owner

invariants.value: every round looked at large beside its reference, never judged on a score
invariants.why: gates and judge scores are not quality

slots.question: What finish and style should the model have?
options: *A Realistic, the materials of its real references
B Stylized: name the art style

slots.question: What is the model's real source?
options: *A A real object: the dossier gathers its pictures and sizes
B An original design: a concept sheet for the owner first

steps: lune run kit start 3d, then lune run kit plan <asset> (the locked stage order)
brief and every reference per part; the model sheet (kit sheet <asset>) approved by the owner
a generated or CAD blockout; the owner approves it
shape, surface (layered materials, colour plan), mechanism: lune run kit asset <name>
look large beside the reference (kit look closeup), show the owner, kit verdict 3d <name> <0-10> "<their words>"
done_when: kit verdict 3d <name> recorded from the owner's words
engine_caps: a texture's download is a 1024 copy; a game keeps up to 4096
at most 100 unique PBR maps in a scene (arena budget)

failure_lexicon.blurry: maps at 1028 px/m on a hero; crop and look at 1:1 beside the reference
failure_lexicon.fake: every part from its real reference and its sourced size
failure_lexicon.flat: a layered material: base, wear, dirt and dust from measured scans, a three-grey value read
failure_lexicon.blobby: hard parts by CAD, organic parts picture-first and sharpened
failure_lexicon.generic: this object's own references, never the last model's look
